notes:
## Changes
- Film and TV details: add your own free TMDB key in Settings › Online details, and a folder's menu has Film or TV details. Link the folder to a film or a series once. A film fills in its video's title, release date, description, director, cast, genres and certificate, and offers the poster as the folder's cover. A series lists its seasons and episodes, and videos named like S01E02 or 1x02 find their episode by themselves (Match all does them at once). An optional OMDb key adds IMDb ratings. Nothing goes online until you turn it on.
- Each category can say what it holds: performers, films or TV (Settings › Categories).
- Videos can have a title, release date, studio code and description (Scene info). Tiles show the title, and search finds it.
- Folders with details looked up online show a small globe beside their name, saying where from when you point at it.
- Unmatch on a video's menu puts back the details it had before.
- Studio logos: SVG logos now work, white logos on a clear background show on a dark tile, and you can put a background colour behind any logo (the logo as it came is kept).
- Performers: attributes show four to a row, the first four in your Settings order always, any more behind Show more.
- Experimental features can be switched on with an access code, in Settings › Online details.
linuxNotes:
First Linux preview of Video Shelf: the whole app on Ubuntu and similar systems (.deb). It uses the same catalogue as the Windows app.

Install with:

    sudo apt install ./videoshelf_0.12.0_amd64.deb
